ژورنال معاملاتی رفتار شما را قابل مشاهده: A trading journal makes your behavior visible. Most traders remember the result of a trade, but forget the context: why they entered, whether the trade followed the plan, how they managed risk, and what emotions influenced the decision. A journal captures these details so they can be reviewed later.

At minimum, record the market, symbol, direction, entry price, exit price, position size, stop loss, take profit, open time, close time, strategy, notes, emotional state, and outcome. A strong journal also tracks whether the trade followed your rules and what you learned from it.
